name: Icing -love coating-
source:
Shigure is an aspiring patissier, along with his wife Akiho, who while loving him unconditionally, also doesn’t like losing in anything. They enjoy their sweet married life together as they work hard towards a common goal, both as lovers and as rivals.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2020/03/26/march-2020-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
时雨是一位有抱负的糕点师，他的妻子秋穗虽然无条件地爱着他，但也不喜欢失去任何东西。他们一起享受甜蜜的婚姻生活，为一个共同的目标而努力，既是恋人也是对手。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2020/03/26/march-2020-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
